questions.stem: Which of the following is mentioned as a common skin condition during adolescence?
questions.solution: Acne is a common skin condition during adolescence, often caused by increased oil production in the skin. Eczema, psoriasis, and rash are not specifically linked to adolescence in the context of this question. The correct answer is acne because it is directly associated with the hormonal changes that occur during this stage of life.

hi.solution: अस्पति किशोरावस्था के दौरान एक सामान्य त्वचा की स्थिति है, जो आमतौर पर त्वचा में तेल के उत्पादन में वृद्धि के कारण होती है। एक्जीमा, पांसरियासिस और रैश किशोरावस्था के संदर्भ में विशेष रूप से जुड़े नहीं हैं। सही उत्तर अस्पति है क्योंकि यह इस जीवन चरण में होने वाले हार्मोनल परिवर्तनों से सीधे रूप से जुड़ी हुई है।

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of maintaining good personal hygiene during adolescence?
choices: To prevent the spread of diseases
questions.solution: The main purpose of maintaining good personal hygiene during adolescence is to avoid getting sick. While looking more attractive, preventing the spread of diseases, and growing taller may have some connection, the primary reason is to maintain health and prevent illness.

questions.stem: If a student notices that their voice is becoming hoarse, which stage of life are they most likely in?
questions.solution: During adolescence, the voice box grows, which can cause the voice to become hoarse. This is a natural physical change that occurs during this stage of life. Infancy and childhood do not involve significant voice changes, and old age is not associated with this specific development. The correct answer is adolescence because it directly relates to the physiological changes in the vocal system.

hi.stem: यदि एक छात्र को अपनी आवाज में रूखापन बरता हुआ ध्यान आता है, तो वे निश्चित रूप से किस जीवन चरण में हो सकते हैं?
hi.solution: किशोरावस्था के दौरान आवाज का बॉक्स बढ़ता है, जिसके कारण आवाज रूखी हो सकती है। यह इस जीवन चरण में होने वाले एक प्राकृतिक शारीरिक परिवर्तन है। शिशुत्व और बाल्यावस्था में आवाज में महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तन नहीं होते हैं, और वृद्धावस्था इस विशिष्ट विकास से जुड़ी नहीं है। सही उत्तर किशोरावस्था है क्योंकि यह आवाज प्रणाली में शारीरिक परिवर्तनों से सीधे संबंधित है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All options and the solution are correctly translated, with the correct answer (option 2) maintaining its position and validity.

mr.stem: जर एका विद्यार्थ्याला लक्षात येते की त्याचा आवाज अस्वस्थ होत आहे, तर ते जीवनाच्या कोणत्या टप्प्यात असण्याची शक्यता अधिक आहे?
mr.solution: किशोरपालात, आवाजाचा बॉक्स वाढतो, जे आवाज अस्वस्थ होण्यास कारणीभूत ठरू शकतो. हे जीवनाच्या या टप्प्यात होणारा प्राकृतिक शारीरिक बदल आहे. शिशुपाल आणि बालपणात आवाजाच्या महत्त्वाच्या बदलांची नोंद नाही, आणि वृद्धावस्था हा विशिष्ट विकासाशी संबंधित नाही. योग्य उत्तर किशोरपाल आहे कारण हे आवाज प्रणालीतील शारीरिक बदलाशी सीधा संबंध असतो.

questions.stem: If a girl experiences irregular menstrual cycles, what could be a possible reason?
choices: It indicates a serious health issue
It is a sign of infertility
It is caused by poor nutrition
questions.solution: Irregular menstrual cycles can be a normal variation as the length of cycles can naturally differ among individuals. The other options are not universally true, as irregularity does not always indicate a serious health issue, infertility, or poor nutrition.

questions.stem: What should a student do if they encounter cyberbullying on social media?
choices: Ignore it and continue using social media
Report it to the school authorities
Share the bullying message with others
Delete their social media account immediately
questions.solution: Reporting cyberbullying to school authorities is the correct action because it allows trained individuals to address the issue and provide support. Ignoring it may let the behavior continue, sharing the message can spread harm, and deleting the account may not resolve the underlying problem.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about adolescence?
choices: It is only a physical change
It involves emotional and behavioural changes
It starts at the age of 15
It ends at the age of 25
questions.solution: Adolescence involves emotional and behavioural changes, as it is a period of significant development beyond just physical growth. The other options are incorrect because adolescence is not limited to physical changes, does not exclusively start at 15, and does not necessarily end at 25.

questions.stem: Shalu said, 'Adolescence brings only physical changes, like growing taller or developing body hair.' What would be a correct response to her statement?

She is incorrect because adolescence includes emotional changes

hi.stem: शालू ने कहा, 'किशोरावस्था में केवल शारीरिक परिवर्तन होते हैं, जैसे लंबा हो जाना या शरीर के बाल विकसित हो जाना।' उसके कथन के लिए एक सही उत्तर क्या होगा?
choices: वह सही है क्योंकि शारीरिक परिवर्तन मुख्य हैं
वह गलत है क्योंकि किशोरावस्था में भावनात्मक परिवर्तन भी शामिल हैं
वह सही है क्योंकि शरीर के बाल एक मुख्य चिह्न है
वह गलत है क्योंकि किशोरावस्था केवल वृद्धि के बारे में है
hi.solution: वह गलत है क्योंकि किशोरावस्था में भावनात्मक परिवर्तन भी शामिल हैं। किशोरावस्था केवल शारीरिक परिवर्तन से नहीं बल्कि भावनात्मक और व्यवहारिक विकास से भी संबंधित है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे या तो अपूर्ण दृष्टिकोण का समर्थन करते हैं या किशोरावस्था के परिवर्तनों को गलत तरीके से सीमित करते हैं।

questions.stem: If a girl is not getting enough iron in her diet, what health problem may she face?
questions.solution: Anemia occurs when the body lacks enough red blood cells or hemoglobin, which is essential for carrying oxygen. Iron is a key component of hemoglobin, so a deficiency in iron can lead to anemia. Osteoporosis is related to calcium and vitamin D, diabetes is linked to blood sugar regulation, and hypertension is associated with sodium and heart health.

questions.stem: If a student starts using addictive substances, what is the first step they should take to overcome addiction?
choices: Seek help from family and friends
questions.solution: The first step in overcoming addiction is seeking help from family and friends because they can provide emotional support and encouragement. While exercising and consulting a doctor are helpful, they are not the initial action recommended. Avoiding social interactions would isolate the person and hinder recovery.
